decision: Permit an independently qualified same-period annual snapshot to fill an absent or rejected historical cell; never permit it to hide a qualified-source conflict
gates: Snapshot must match an existing history column; it cannot create a period
Incorrect history is retained with rejection reasons; replacement provenance and version must be traceable
All qualified candidates must agree; collect across each array, repeated history periods and snapshots before selection
Disagreement is withheld unless explicit engine evidence records a reviewed supersession/restatement; ordering is not evidence
Absent or unreproduced derivation inputs never become accepted through fallback
Headline must use exactly the accepted table cell and its period; no independent fallback
legacy_test_handling: Original F03 no-value assertion retained as LEGACY compatibility evidence. It fails when a valid snapshot replaces invalid history, without proving the wrong-date fact was displayed. Policy tests separately require rejection without an eligible snapshot and accept only correctly identified replacement. Historical failures are not overwritten or relabelled PASS.
F01_correction: company.currency=SAR supplied in fixture; repaired KeyFigure period accessor f.period replaces f.cell.period; assertion strengthened to exact accepted table-cell equality and matching unit, key and period
